notes.subject: other
notes.text: Phone numbers use area code (787), and occasionally 939, across the whole island.

notes.subject: sign
notes.text: Stop signs say PARE instead of STOP.

notes.subject: sign
notes.text: Highway shields have their own designs for primary, urban, secondary and tertiary roads, found nowhere else.

notes.subject: sign
notes.text: Tall green kilometre markers with 'km' at the top and a large vertical number below.

notes.subject: sign
notes.text: Speed limit signs match the mainland American shape but are always in the local language rather than English.

notes.subject: language
notes.text: Signs are often in the island's main language rather than English.

notes.subject: other
notes.text: Mainland American store chains, such as Wal-Mart, are very common, unlike nearby Latin American countries.

notes.subject: plate
notes.text: Front plates are not mandatory, so cars with them are rare. This separates it from Guam and the Northern Mariana Islands.

notes.subject: car
notes.text: Nearly all coverage uses a low smallcam with a wide, rounded front blur and an often visible antenna.

notes.subject: car
notes.text: The older car has an antenna at the front right with a small white dot on the tip.

notes.subject: other
notes.text: Much of the rural coverage is on big divided highways.

notes.subject: architecture
notes.text: Most homes are concrete with flat roofs, and metal gates in front are common, especially in cities.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: The south often looks noticeably drier than the rest of the island.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: The north and south coasts have flat coastal plains or rolling hills.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: Mountains are in the middle of the island, where coverage is mostly limited to divided highways.

notes.subject: architecture
notes.text: The southern city of Ponce has a mix of Victorian and Iberian revival styles, often wood and masonry.

notes.subject: architecture
notes.text: The old town in the far northwest of the capital has narrow, colourful streets, some made of brick.
